ROS 2 middleware

AXON

A purpose-built ROS 2 RMW pairing a Rust transport core with a C++ ROS 2 adapter: shared-memory ring buffers on the same host, QUIC between hosts, daemon-based discovery, and selectable classic or post-quantum remote-security profiles.

API reference

axon_core (Rust) Generated rustdoc for the transport core: sessions, shared memory, QUIC, daemon, QoS, and security modules.

Guides

Architecture Two-layer design, a source map for every file, control vs data plane, the publish and discovery paths, and where each test lives. Cryptography Configuration matrix, key derivation, exact wire formats, context binding, replay protection, and fail-closed enforcement. Post-quantum security Security profiles, threat model, the claims that are and are not supported, and the evaluation plan. QKD deployment Credentials, two-host setup, session lifetime, failure behavior, and security boundaries.
